code Python
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings
from pydantic import Field
import os


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    """Application configuration settings."""

    # Google Gemini API configuration
    # Uses the modern Google GenAI SDK (google-genai)
    GEMINI_API_KEY: str = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY", "")
    )
    GEMINI_MODEL: str = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: os.getenv("GEMINI_MODEL", "gemini-2.5-flash")
    )

    # Server settings
    APP_NAME: str = "EduGenie"
    APP_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"
    APP_HOST: str = Field(default_factory=lambda: os.getenv("APP_HOST", "127.0.0.1"))
    APP_PORT: int = Field(default_factory=lambda: int(os.getenv("APP_PORT", "8000")))
    DEBUG: bool = Field(default_factory=lambda: os.getenv("DEBUG", "False").lower() in ("true", "1", "yes"))

    model_config = {
        "env_file": ".env",
        "env_file_encoding": "utf-8",
        "extra": "ignore"
    }


settings = Settings()

from typing import List
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Health Check Schema
# ---------------------------------------------------------
class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str = Field(default="ok", example="ok")
    service: str = Field(default="EduGenie", example="EduGenie")


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Generic Error Response Schema
# ---------------------------------------------------------
class ErrorResponse(BaseModel):
    detail: str = Field(..., description="Explanation of the error")


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Feature 1: Question Answering
# ---------------------------------------------------------
class QARequest(BaseModel):
    question: str = Field(
        ...,
        min_length=2,
        max_length=2000,
        description="Academic or general educational question",
        example="Which is the largest ocean on Earth?"
    )


class QAResponse(BaseModel):
    answer: str = Field(..., description="Accurate, concise, student-friendly answer")


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Feature 2: Concept Explanation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
class ExplainRequest(BaseModel):
    topic: str = Field(
        ...,
        min_length=2,
        max_length=300,
        description="The concept or academic topic to explain",
        example="Pythagoras theorem"
    )


class ExplainResponse(BaseModel):
    explanation: str = Field(
        ...,
        description="Structured explanation with definition, how it works, key points, example, and memory tip"
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Feature 3: Quiz Generation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
class QuizRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str = Field(
        ...,
        min_length=10,
        max_length=15000,
        description="Educational passage or topic notes to generate quiz from",
        example="Photosynthesis is the process used by plants to convert light energy into chemical energy."
    )
    count: int = Field(
        default=3,
        ge=1,
        le=10,
        description="Number of quiz questions to generate (e.g. 3, 5, or 10)",
        example=3
    )


class QuizQuestion(BaseModel):
    question: str = Field(..., description="The multiple choice question")
    options: List[str] = Field(
        ...,
        min_length=4,
        max_length=4,
        description="Exactly 4 distinct choices"
    )
    answer: str = Field(..., description="The correct answer matching one of the options")


class QuizResponse(BaseModel):
    questions: List[QuizQuestion] = Field(..., description="List of generated quiz questions")


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Feature 4: Summarization
# ---------------------------------------------------------
class SummarizeRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str = Field(
        ...,
        min_length=10,
        max_length=20000,
        description="Educational text or study material to summarize",
        example="The Industrial Revolution was the transition to new manufacturing processes..."
    )


class SummarizeResponse(BaseModel):
    summary: str = Field(..., description="Clear, concise, revision-friendly summary")


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Feature 5: Personalized Learning Path
# ---------------------------------------------------------
class LearningPathRequest(BaseModel):
    topic: str = Field(
        ...,
        min_length=2,
        max_length=300,
        description="Topic to generate a curriculum for",
        example="SQL"
    )
    level: str = Field(
        default="beginner",
        pattern="^(beginner|intermediate|advanced)$",
        description="User mastery level: beginner, intermediate, or advanced",
        example="beginner"
    )


class LearningStep(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(..., description="Title of the milestone/step")
    difficulty: str = Field(..., description="Step difficulty level (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced)")
    estimated_time: str = Field(..., description="Estimated completion duration (e.g., '3 days', '1 week')")
    topics: List[str] = Field(..., description="Core subtopics to master in this step")
    resources: List[str] = Field(..., description="Recommended study materials, documentation, or exercises")


class LearningPathResponse(BaseModel):
    topic: str = Field(..., description="Requested topic")
    level: str = Field(..., description="Requested user level")
    overview: str = Field(..., description="Executive summary of the learning roadmap")
    steps: List[LearningStep] = Field(..., description="Ordered progression steps")
    study_tips: List[str] = Field(..., description="Actionable study strategies")

FILE: EduGenie/gemini_client.py

code Python
import json
import logging
from typing import Optional, Any, Type
from fastapi import HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger("edugenie.gemini")

# Optional import guard for the modern Google GenAI SDK (google-genai)
try:
    from google import genai
    from google.genai import types
    from google.genai.errors import APIError
    GENAI_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:
    GENAI_AVAILABLE = False
    genai = None  # type: ignore
    types = None  # type: ignore
    APIError = Exception  # type: ignore


def get_client() -> Any:
    """
    Returns an initialized instance of the modern Google GenAI Client.
    Safely verifies credentials and SDK availability without crashing at import time.
    """
    if not GENAI_AVAILABLE:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail=(
                "Google GenAI SDK is not installed. "
                "Please run: pip install google-genai"
            )
        )

    api_key = settings.GEMINI_API_KEY
    if not api_key or api_key == "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE" or api_key.strip() == "":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=503,
            detail=(
                "GEMINI_API_KEY is missing or unconfigured. "
                "Please set GEMINI_API_KEY in your .env file or environment variables."
            )
        )

    try:
        return genai.Client(api_key=api_key)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to initialize Gemini Client: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail=f"Failed to initialize Gemini client: {str(e)}"
        )


def generate_text(prompt: str, system_instruction: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    """
    Executes a standard text generation call with Google Gemini.
    """
    client = get_client()
    model = settings.GEMINI_MODEL

    try:
        config = None
        if system_instruction:
            config = types.GenerateContentConfig(
                system_instruction=system_instruction,
                temperature=0.4
            )

        response = client.models.generate_content(
            model=model,
            contents=prompt,
            config=config
        )

        if not response or not response.text:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=502,
                detail="Gemini returned an empty response. Please try again or rephrase your input."
            )

        return response.text.strip()

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except APIError as e:
        logger.error(f"Gemini API Error: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=502,
            detail=f"Google Gemini API error: {str(e)}"
        )
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Unexpected error during generation: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=500,
            detail=f"An unexpected error occurred while communicating with Gemini: {str(e)}"
        )


def generate_structured_json(
    prompt: str,
    schema_class: Type[BaseModel],
    system_instruction: Optional[str] = None
) -> dict:
    """
    Executes a generation call that enforces and extracts valid JSON matching a schema.
    """
    client = get_client()
    model = settings.GEMINI_MODEL

    schema_json_str = json.dumps(schema_class.model_json_schema(), indent=2)
    augmented_prompt = (
        f"{prompt}\n\n"
        f"CRITICAL: You MUST respond ONLY with valid, raw JSON matching this schema:\n"
        f"{schema_json_str}\n"
        f"Do not wrap in markdown quotes if possible, or use standard ```json ... ``` blocks."
    )

    try:
        config = types.GenerateContentConfig(
            response_mime_type="application/json",
            temperature=0.2,
            system_instruction=system_instruction
        )
        response = client.models.generate_content(
            model=model,
            contents=augmented_prompt,
            config=config
        )
    except Exception as primary_err:
        logger.warning(f"Structured response mode attempt failed: {primary_err}. Falling back to standard mode...")
        try:
            config = types.GenerateContentConfig(
                temperature=0.2,
                system_instruction=system_instruction
            )
            response = client.models.generate_content(
                model=model,
                contents=augmented_prompt,
                config=config
            )
        except Exception as fallback_err:
            logger.error(f"Fallback generation failed: {fallback_err}")
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=502,
                detail=f"Gemini generation error: {str(fallback_err)}"
            )

    if not response or not response.text:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=502,
            detail="Gemini returned an empty response."
        )

    raw_text = response.text.strip()
    if raw_text.startswith("```json"):
        raw_text = raw_text[len("```json"):].strip()
    elif raw_text.startswith("```"):
        raw_text = raw_text[len("```"):].strip()
    if raw_text.endswith("```"):
        raw_text = raw_text[:-3].strip()

    try:
        data = json.loads(raw_text)
        return data
    except json.JSONDecodeError as decode_err:
        logger.error(f"Failed to parse JSON response: {raw_text}\nError: {decode_err}")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=502,
            detail=f"AI model did not return valid JSON. Error: {str(decode_err)}"
        )

from gemini_client import generate_text


SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION = (
    "You are EduGenie, an expert, patient, and friendly academic tutor. "
    "Your goal is to answer student questions clearly, concisely, and accurately. "
    "Use intuitive language, avoid unnecessary jargon, and structure the explanation "
    "so that concepts are immediately understandable to learners of all levels. "
    "Highlight key concepts when helpful, but stay focused and direct."
)


def answer_question(question: str) -> str:
    """
    Processes an academic or educational question and returns a concise, student-friendly answer.
    """
    prompt = (
        f"Student Question: {question}\n\n"
        "Provide an accurate, concise, and student-friendly answer. "
        "Explain the core concept in plain language, followed by a brief real-world context if helpful."
    )
    return generate_text(prompt=prompt, system_instruction=SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION)

code Python
from gemini_client import generate_text


SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION = (
    "You are EduGenie's concept explanation specialist. "
    "You break down complex, intimidating academic and scientific topics into intuitive, easy-to-digest formats. "
    "Always maintain a clear, encouraging tone tailored for students."
)


def explain_concept(topic: str) -> str:
    """
    Explains an educational concept or topic with:
    - Simple definition
    - How it works
    - Important points
    - Example
    - Memory tip
    """
    prompt = f"""Explain the following topic thoroughly and engagingly: '{topic}'.

Format your response strictly using these structured sections:

### 1. Simple Definition
(A 1-2 sentence high-level definition that anyone can understand without prerequisites)

### 2. How It Works
(A step-by-step breakdown of the mechanics, core principles, or underlying logic)

### 3. Important Points to Remember
(3-4 bullet points highlighting essential takeaways or common stumbling blocks)

### 4. Real-World Example
(A relatable everyday scenario or concrete worked-out application)

### 5. Memory Tip / Mnemonic
(A catchy rhyme, acronym, visual metaphor, or trick to remember this concept forever)
"""
    return generate_text(prompt=prompt, system_instruction=SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION)

import logging
from typing import Dict, Any
from fastapi import HTTPException
from gemini_client import generate_structured_json
from schemas import QuizResponse, QuizQuestion

logger = logging.getLogger("edugenie.quiz")

SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION = (
    "You are EduGenie's assessment and quiz master. "
    "Your job is to generate fair, rigorous, and educational multiple-choice questions "
    "based strictly on the provided passage or subject matter. "
    "Ensure distractors are plausible and the designated correct answer is unmistakably accurate."
)


def generate_quiz(text: str, count: int = 3) -> QuizResponse:
    """
    Generates an educational multiple-choice quiz based on the provided text passage.
    Enforces:
    - Exactly `count` questions
    - Exactly 4 options per question
    - Exactly 1 correct answer that exists within the 4 options
    """
    prompt = f"""Generate an educational multiple-choice quiz of EXACTLY {count} questions based on this study text:

---
{text}
---

Rules:
1. Generate exactly {count} distinct questions.
2. Each question MUST have exactly 4 choices in the 'options' array.
3. The 'answer' string MUST be an exact verbatim match to one of the 4 options in the 'options' array.
4. Test key conceptual understanding and factual details.
"""

    data = generate_structured_json(
        prompt=prompt,
        schema_class=QuizResponse,
        system_instruction=SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION
    )

    try:
        if isinstance(data, dict) and "questions" in data:
            raw_questions = data["questions"]
        elif isinstance(data, list):
            raw_questions = data
            data = {"questions": raw_questions}
        else:
            raise ValueError("Expected dictionary with 'questions' key or list of questions")

        validated_questions = []
        for idx, q_data in enumerate(raw_questions):
            question_text = q_data.get("question", "").strip()
            options = [str(opt).strip() for opt in q_data.get("options", []) if str(opt).strip()]
            answer = str(q_data.get("answer", "")).strip()

            # Ensure exactly 4 options
            if len(options) < 4:
                while len(options) < 4:
                    options.append(f"Option {chr(65 + len(options))}")
            elif len(options) > 4:
                options = options[:4]

            # Ensure answer matches one of the options
            if answer not in options:
                if answer.upper() in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
                    letter_idx = ord(answer.upper()) - 65
                    if letter_idx < len(options):
                        answer = options[letter_idx]
                    else:
                        answer = options[0]
                else:
                    options[3] = answer

            validated_questions.append(
                QuizQuestion(
                    question=question_text or f"Question {idx + 1}",
                    options=options,
                    answer=answer
                )
            )

        final_questions = validated_questions[:count]
        if not final_questions:
            raise ValueError("No questions could be extracted from model output")

        return QuizResponse(questions=final_questions)

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error parsing quiz response: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=502,
            detail=f"Failed to generate structured quiz from AI response: {str(e)}"
        )

from gemini_client import generate_text

SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION = (
    "You are EduGenie's academic summarization specialist. "
    "Your objective is to produce concise, high-yield summaries designed for student revision. "
    "Preserve key facts, dates, mechanisms, and definitions accurately. "
    "Remove redundant sentences and fluff. "
    "Never hallucinate or extrapolate facts beyond what is in or directly implied by the source material."
)


def summarize_text(text: str) -> str:
    """
    Summarizes long educational text into a structured, revision-ready summary.
    """
    prompt = f"""Summarize the following educational passage:

---
{text}
---

Your response must include:
1. **Core Takeaway:** (A crisp 1-2 sentence essence of the passage)
2. **Key Concepts & Findings:** (Bulleted points highlighting essential facts, definitions, or mechanisms)
3. **Quick Revision Notes:** (High-impact bulleted summary items for rapid exam prep)

Keep the language student-friendly, clear, and focused on learning retention.
"""
    return generate_text(prompt=prompt, system_instruction=SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION)

import logging
from fastapi import HTTPException
from gemini_client import generate_structured_json
from schemas import LearningPathResponse, LearningStep

logger = logging.getLogger("edugenie.learning_path")

SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION = (
    "You are EduGenie's personalized curriculum designer and educational mentor. "
    "Your objective is to craft realistic, step-by-step learning paths that take a student "
    "from their current mastery level to practical, competent understanding of any topic."
)


def generate_learning_path(topic: str, level: str = "beginner") -> LearningPathResponse:
    """
    Generates a personalized, step-by-step curriculum for a given topic and difficulty level.
    """
    prompt = f"""Design a comprehensive, structured learning path for the topic '{topic}' targeted for a '{level}' student.

Requirements:
1. Provide an inspiring, educational 'overview' of the journey.
2. Provide between 4 and 6 sequential 'steps' (milestones).
   Each step must have:
   - 'title': Descriptive milestone name
   - 'difficulty': e.g., 'Beginner', 'Intermediate', or 'Advanced'
   - 'estimated_time': Realistic duration (e.g., '3 days', '1 week')
   - 'topics': List of 3-5 specific technical or conceptual subjects covered
   - 'resources': List of 2-3 recommended free books, documentation, practice platforms, or projects
3. Provide a list of 4-5 practical, motivating 'study_tips' tailored specifically to learning '{topic}'.
"""

    data = generate_structured_json(
        prompt=prompt,
        schema_class=LearningPathResponse,
        system_instruction=SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION
    )

    try:
        parsed_steps = []
        raw_steps = data.get("steps", [])
        for step in raw_steps:
            parsed_steps.append(
                LearningStep(
                    title=step.get("title", "Milestone"),
                    difficulty=step.get("difficulty", level.capitalize()),
                    estimated_time=step.get("estimated_time", "1 week"),
                    topics=[str(t) for t in step.get("topics", [])],
                    resources=[str(r) for r in step.get("resources", [])]
                )
            )

        return LearningPathResponse(
            topic=data.get("topic", topic),
            level=data.get("level", level),
            overview=data.get("overview", f"A tailored {level} curriculum for mastering {topic}."),
            steps=parsed_steps,
            study_tips=[str(t) for t in data.get("study_tips", [])]
        )

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error parsing learning path response: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=502,
            detail=f"Failed to generate structured learning path: {str(e)}"
        )

import os
import uvicorn
from pathlib import Path
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, JSONResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from config import settings
from schemas import (
    HealthResponse,
    ErrorResponse,
    QARequest,
    QAResponse,
    ExplainRequest,
    ExplainResponse,
    QuizRequest,
    QuizResponse,
    SummarizeRequest,
    SummarizeResponse,
    LearningPathRequest,
    LearningPathResponse
)
from qna import answer_question
from explanation_module import explain_concept
from quiz_module import generate_quiz
from summary_module import summarize_text
from learning_path import generate_learning_path


# Define base directories
BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
STATIC_DIR = BASE_DIR / "static"
TEMPLATES_DIR = BASE_DIR / "templates"

# Initialize FastAPI application
app = FastAPI(
    title=settings.APP_NAME,
    version=settings.APP_VERSION,
    description="EduGenie – Google Gemini Powered Educational Assistant for Students",
    docs_url="/docs",
    redoc_url="/redoc"
)

# Configure CORS
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

# Ensure static & templates directory exist
STATIC_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
TEMPLATES_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Mount static files
app.mount("/static", StaticFiles(directory=str(STATIC_DIR)), name="static")

# Configure Jinja2 templates
templates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(TEMPLATES_DIR))


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Exception Handlers
# ---------------------------------------------------------
@app.exception_handler(HTTPException)
async def http_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: HTTPException):
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=exc.status_code,
        content={"detail": exc.detail}
    )


@app.exception_handler(Exception)
async def generic_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception):
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        content={"detail": f"Internal server error: {str(exc)}"}
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Web Interface Routes
# ---------------------------------------------------------
@app.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse, summary="EduGenie Web Dashboard")
async def index(request: Request):
    """
    Renders the modern EduGenie educational dashboard.
    """
    return templates.TemplateResponse(
        "index.html",
        {
            "request": request,
            "app_name": settings.APP_NAME,
            "version": settings.APP_VERSION,
            "model_name": settings.GEMINI_MODEL,
        }
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Health Check Route
# ---------------------------------------------------------
@app.get(
    "/health",
    response_model=HealthResponse,
    summary="Health Check",
    tags=["System"]
)
async def health():
    """
    Returns system status and service name.
    """
    return HealthResponse(status="ok", service="EduGenie")


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Feature 1: Question Answering
# ---------------------------------------------------------
@app.post(
    "/qa",
    response_model=QAResponse,
    responses={502: {"model": ErrorResponse}, 503: {"model": ErrorResponse}},
    summary="Academic Q&A",
    tags=["Academic Tools"]
)
async def question_answering(payload: QARequest):
    """
    Answers academic and educational questions with clear, student-friendly explanations.
    """
    answer = answer_question(payload.question)
    return QAResponse(answer=answer)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Feature 2: Concept Explanation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
@app.post(
    "/explain",
    response_model=ExplainResponse,
    responses={502: {"model": ErrorResponse}, 503: {"model": ErrorResponse}},
    summary="Concept Explanation",
    tags=["Academic Tools"]
)
async def concept_explanation(payload: ExplainRequest):
    """
    Provides a deep structured breakdown: Simple definition, How it works, Key points, Example, and Memory tip.
    """
    explanation = explain_concept(payload.topic)
    return ExplainResponse(explanation=explanation)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Feature 3: Quiz Generation
# ---------------------------------------------------------
@app.post(
    "/quiz",
    response_model=QuizResponse,
    responses={502: {"model": ErrorResponse}, 503: {"model": ErrorResponse}},
    summary="Generate Multiple Choice Quiz",
    tags=["Assessment"]
)
async def quiz_generation(payload: QuizRequest):
    """
    Generates a structured multiple-choice quiz with exactly 4 options and verified answers.
    """
    quiz = generate_quiz(text=payload.text, count=payload.count)
    return quiz


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Feature 4: Text Summarization
# ---------------------------------------------------------
@app.post(
    "/summarize",
    response_model=SummarizeResponse,
    responses={502: {"model": ErrorResponse}, 503: {"model": ErrorResponse}},
    summary="Educational Summarization",
    tags=["Revision"]
)
async def summarize(payload: SummarizeRequest):
    """
    Summarizes long educational text into revision notes and key takeaways.
    """
    summary = summarize_text(payload.text)
    return SummarizeResponse(summary=summary)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Feature 5: Personalized Learning Path
# ---------------------------------------------------------
@app.post(
    "/learn/recommendations",
    response_model=LearningPathResponse,
    responses={502: {"model": ErrorResponse}, 503: {"model": ErrorResponse}},
    summary="Personalized Learning Path",
    tags=["Roadmaps"]
)
async def learning_recommendations(payload: LearningPathRequest):
    """
    Generates tailored, step-by-step learning milestones from beginner to advanced.
    """
    path = generate_learning_path(topic=payload.topic, level=payload.level)
    return path


if __name__ == "__main__":
    uvicorn.run(
        "main:app",
        host=settings.APP_HOST,
        port=settings.APP_PORT,
        reload=settings.DEBUG
    )

/**
 * EduGenie - Educational Assistant Frontend Logic
 */

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  initHealthCheck();
  initTabs();
  initCharCounters();
  initQuizSegments();
  initFormSubmissions();
});

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 1. Health Status Check
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function initHealthCheck() {
  const statusEl = document.getElementById("health-status");
  const textEl = statusEl.querySelector(".status-text");

  try {
    const res = await fetch("/health");
    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json();
      statusEl.className = "status-indicator online";
      textEl.textContent = `${data.service} Ready`;
    } else {
      throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    statusEl.className = "status-indicator offline";
    textEl.textContent = "Service Offline";
  }
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 2. Tab Navigation
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function initTabs() {
  const pills = document.querySelectorAll(".feature-pill");
  const panels = document.querySelectorAll(".tool-panel");

  pills.forEach(pill => {
    pill.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const targetId = pill.getAttribute("data-tab");

      pills.forEach(p => p.classList.remove("active"));
      panels.forEach(pan => pan.classList.remove("active"));

      pill.classList.add("active");
      const targetPanel = document.getElementById(targetId);
      if (targetPanel) {
        targetPanel.classList.add("active");
      }
    });
  });
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 3. Example Fillers
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
window.fillExample = function(tool, value, extra) {
  if (tool === "qa") {
    const input = document.getElementById("input-qa-question");
    input.value = value;
    triggerInput(input);
  } else if (tool === "explain") {
    const input = document.getElementById("input-explain-topic");
    input.value = value;
    triggerInput(input);
  } else if (tool === "quiz") {
    const input = document.getElementById("input-quiz-text");
    input.value = value;
    triggerInput(input);
  } else if (tool === "summarize") {
    const input = document.getElementById("input-summarize-text");
    input.value = value;
    triggerInput(input);
  } else if (tool === "learn") {
    const input = document.getElementById("input-learn-topic");
    input.value = value;
    if (extra) {
      const radio = document.querySelector(`input[name="learn-level"][value="${extra}"]`);
      if (radio) radio.checked = true;
    }
  }
};

function triggerInput(el) {
  el.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  el.focus();
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 4. Character Counters
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function initCharCounters() {
  bindCounter("input-qa-question", "count-qa", 2000);
  bindCounter("input-explain-topic", "count-explain", 300);
  bindCounter("input-summarize-text", "count-summarize", 20000);
}

function bindCounter(inputId, counterId, max) {
  const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
  const counter = document.getElementById(counterId);
  if (!input || !counter) return;

  input.addEventListener("input", () => {
    counter.textContent = `${input.value.length} / ${max}`;
  });
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 5. Quiz Count Segmented Control
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
let selectedQuizCount = 3;

function initQuizSegments() {
  const segments = document.querySelectorAll(".segment-btn");
  segments.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      segments.forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
      btn.classList.add("active");
      selectedQuizCount = parseInt(btn.getAttribute("data-count"), 10) || 3;
    });
  });
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 6. Form Submissions & API Communication
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function initFormSubmissions() {
  // Q&A Form
  const formQA = document.getElementById("form-qa");
  formQA.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const question = document.getElementById("input-qa-question").value.trim();
    if (!question) return;

    setLoading("btn-qa", true);
    hideElement("output-qa");

    try {
      const data = await apiRequest("/qa", { question });
      const contentEl = document.getElementById("content-qa");
      contentEl.innerHTML = formatMarkdown(data.answer);
      showElement("output-qa");
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setLoading("btn-qa", false);
    }
  });

  // Explain Form
  const formExplain = document.getElementById("form-explain");
  formExplain.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const topic = document.getElementById("input-explain-topic").value.trim();
    if (!topic) return;

    setLoading("btn-explain", true);
    hideElement("output-explain");

    try {
      const data = await apiRequest("/explain", { topic });
      const contentEl = document.getElementById("content-explain");
      contentEl.innerHTML = formatMarkdown(data.explanation);
      showElement("output-explain");
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setLoading("btn-explain", false);
    }
  });

  // Quiz Form
  const formQuiz = document.getElementById("form-quiz");
  formQuiz.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const text = document.getElementById("input-quiz-text").value.trim();
    if (!text) return;

    setLoading("btn-quiz", true);
    hideElement("output-quiz");

    try {
      const data = await apiRequest("/quiz", {
        text,
        count: selectedQuizCount
      });
      renderQuiz(data.questions || []);
      showElement("output-quiz");
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setLoading("btn-quiz", false);
    }
  });

  // Summarize Form
  const formSummarize = document.getElementById("form-summarize");
  formSummarize.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const text = document.getElementById("input-summarize-text").value.trim();
    if (!text) return;

    setLoading("btn-summarize", true);
    hideElement("output-summarize");

    try {
      const data = await apiRequest("/summarize", { text });
      const contentEl = document.getElementById("content-summarize");
      contentEl.innerHTML = formatMarkdown(data.summary);
      showElement("output-summarize");
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setLoading("btn-summarize", false);
    }
  });

  // Learning Path Form
  const formLearn = document.getElementById("form-learn");
  formLearn.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const topic = document.getElementById("input-learn-topic").value.trim();
    const levelRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="learn-level"]:checked');
    const level = levelRadio ? levelRadio.value : "beginner";

    if (!topic) return;

    setLoading("btn-learn", true);
    hideElement("output-learn");

    try {
      const data = await apiRequest("/learn/recommendations", { topic, level });
      renderLearningPath(data);
      showElement("output-learn");
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setLoading("btn-learn", false);
    }
  });
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 7. Generic API Fetch Client
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
async function apiRequest(endpoint, payload) {
  const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "Accept": "application/json"
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    let errorDetail = `Request failed (HTTP ${response.status})`;
    try {
      const errorJson = await response.json();
      if (errorJson.detail) {
        if (typeof errorJson.detail === "string") {
          errorDetail = errorJson.detail;
        } else if (Array.isArray(errorJson.detail)) {
          errorDetail = errorJson.detail.map(d => `${d.loc ? d.loc.join('.') : ''}: ${d.msg}`).join("; ");
        } else {
          errorDetail = JSON.stringify(errorJson.detail);
        }
      }
    } catch (parseErr) {
      // Non-json error fallback
    }
    throw new Error(errorDetail);
  }

  return await response.json();
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 8. Quiz Rendering & State Management
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
let quizScore = 0;
let answeredQuestions = 0;

function renderQuiz(questions) {
  const container = document.getElementById("quiz-cards-container");
  const scoreEl = document.getElementById("quiz-score");
  const totalEl = document.getElementById("quiz-total");

  container.innerHTML = "";
  quizScore = 0;
  answeredQuestions = 0;
  scoreEl.textContent = "0";
  totalEl.textContent = questions.length;

  questions.forEach((q, qIndex) => {
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "quiz-question-card";

    const numBadge = document.createElement("div");
    numBadge.className = "quiz-q-num";
    numBadge.textContent = `Question ${qIndex + 1} of ${questions.length}`;

    const qText = document.createElement("h4");
    qText.className = "quiz-q-text";
    qText.textContent = q.question;

    const optionsList = document.createElement("div");
    optionsList.className = "quiz-options-list";

    const optionLetters = ["A", "B", "C", "D"];

    q.options.forEach((optText, optIndex) => {
      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.type = "button";
      btn.className = "quiz-option-btn";
      btn.innerHTML = `
        <span class="option-letter">${optionLetters[optIndex]}</span>
        <span class="option-text">${escapeHtml(optText)}</span>
      `;

      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        handleQuizChoice(btn, optText, q.answer, optionsList, card);
      });

      optionsList.appendChild(btn);
    });

    card.appendChild(numBadge);
    card.appendChild(qText);
    card.appendChild(optionsList);
    container.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function handleQuizChoice(clickedBtn, selectedText, correctAnswer, optionsList, card) {
  const allOptionBtns = optionsList.querySelectorAll(".quiz-option-btn");
  allOptionBtns.forEach(btn => btn.disabled = true);

  const isCorrect = selectedText.trim().toLowerCase() === correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase();
  
  const feedback = document.createElement("div");

  if (isCorrect) {
    clickedBtn.classList.add("correct");
    feedback.className = "quiz-feedback correct";
    feedback.innerHTML = `✓ <strong>Correct!</strong> Well done.`;
    quizScore += 1;
  } else {
    clickedBtn.classList.add("wrong");
    feedback.className = "quiz-feedback wrong";
    feedback.innerHTML = `✕ <strong>Incorrect.</strong> The correct answer is: <em>${escapeHtml(correctAnswer)}</em>`;

    allOptionBtns.forEach(btn => {
      const textSpan = btn.querySelector(".option-text");
      if (textSpan && textSpan.textContent.trim().toLowerCase() === correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase()) {
        btn.classList.add("correct");
      }
    });
  }

  card.appendChild(feedback);
  answeredQuestions += 1;
  document.getElementById("quiz-score").textContent = quizScore;
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 9. Learning Path Rendering
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function renderLearningPath(data) {
  const titleEl = document.getElementById("title-learn");
  const overviewEl = document.getElementById("overview-learn");
  const stepsEl = document.getElementById("steps-learn");
  const tipsEl = document.getElementById("tips-learn");
  const rawContentEl = document.getElementById("content-learn");

  titleEl.textContent = `${data.topic} Roadmap (${data.level.toUpperCase()})`;
  overviewEl.textContent = data.overview;

  stepsEl.innerHTML = "";
  (data.steps || []).forEach((step, idx) => {
    const stepEl = document.createElement("div");
    stepEl.className = "timeline-step";
    stepEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="step-marker">${idx + 1}</div>
      <div class="step-content">
        <div class="step-title-row">
          <h4 class="step-title">${escapeHtml(step.title)}</h4>
          <div class="step-meta">
            <span class="step-pill">${escapeHtml(step.difficulty)}</span>
            <span class="step-pill">⏱ ${escapeHtml(step.estimated_time)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="step-topics">
          <div class="step-subtitle">Key Topics Covered:</div>
          <div class="subtopic-tags">
            ${(step.topics || []).map(t => `<span class="subtopic-tag">${escapeHtml(t)}</span>`).join("")}
          </div>
        </div>

        ${step.resources && step.resources.length > 0 ? `
          <div class="step-resources">
            <div class="step-subtitle">Recommended Resources:</div>
            <ul>
              ${step.resources.map(r => `<li>${escapeHtml(r)}</li>`).join("")}
            </ul>
          </div>
        ` : ''}
      </div>
    `;
    stepsEl.appendChild(stepEl);
  });

  if (data.study_tips && data.study_tips.length > 0) {
    tipsEl.innerHTML = `
      <h4>Study & Retention Tips:</h4>
      <ul>
        ${data.study_tips.map(tip => `<li>${escapeHtml(tip)}</li>`).join("")}
      </ul>
    `;
    showElement("tips-learn");
  } else {
    hideElement("tips-learn");
  }

  rawContentEl.textContent = JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 10. Markdown & Text Formatting Helper
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function formatMarkdown(text) {
  if (!text) return "";
  let html = escapeHtml(text);

  // Bold
  html = html.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
  
  // Headers (### Header)
  html = html.replace(/^### (.*$)/gim, '<h3>$1</h3>');
  html = html.replace(/^## (.*$)/gim, '<h2>$1</h2>');
  html = html.replace(/^# (.*$)/gim, '<h1>$1</h1>');

  // Bullet points
  html = html.replace(/^\* (.*$)/gim, '<li>$1</li>');
  html = html.replace(/^- (.*$)/gim, '<li>$1</li>');
  
  html = html.replace(/(<li>.*<\/li>)/gms, '<ul>$1</ul>');
  html = html.replace(/<\/ul>\s*<ul>/g, '');

  html = html.replace(/\n\n+/g, '</p><p>');
  html = `<p>${html}</p>`;
  
  html = html.replace(/<p>\s*<\/p>/g, '');
  html = html.replace(/<p><h([1-3])/g, '<h$1');
  html = html.replace(/<\/h([1-3])><\/p>/g, '</h$1>');
  html = html.replace(/<p><ul/g, '<ul');
  html = html.replace(/<\/ul><\/p>/g, '</ul>');

  return html;
}

function escapeHtml(str) {
  if (typeof str !== "string") return "";
  return str
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// 11. UI Helpers: Loading, Toast, Copy
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function setLoading(buttonId, isLoading) {
  const btn = document.getElementById(buttonId);
  if (!btn) return;

  const textSpan = btn.querySelector(".btn-text");
  const spinner = btn.querySelector(".spinner");

  btn.disabled = isLoading;
  if (isLoading) {
    if (textSpan) textSpan.classList.add("hidden");
    if (spinner) spinner.classList.remove("hidden");
  } else {
    if (textSpan) textSpan.classList.remove("hidden");
    if (spinner) spinner.classList.add("hidden");
  }
}

function showElement(id) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) el.classList.remove("hidden");
}

function hideElement(id) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (el) el.classList.add("hidden");
}

window.copyContent = function(elementId) {
  const el = document.getElementById(elementId);
  if (!el) return;

  const textToCopy = el.innerText || el.textContent;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(textToCopy).then(() => {
    showToast("Copied to clipboard!", "success");
  }).catch(() => {
    showToast("Failed to copy", "error");
  });
};

function showToast(message, type = "info") {
  const container = document.getElementById("toast-container");
  if (!container) return;

  const toast = document.createElement("div");
  toast.className = `toast ${type}`;
  toast.innerHTML = `<span>${escapeHtml(message)}</span>`;

  container.appendChild(toast);

  setTimeout(() => {
    toast.style.opacity = "0";
    toast.style.transform = "translateX(100%)";
    toast.style.transition = "all 0.25s ease";
    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 250);
  }, 4000);
}

    sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))

from main import app

client = TestClient(app)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Root & Health Check Tests

def test_get_root():
    """Verify the root UI route loads correctly with 200 OK."""
    response = client.get("/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert "EduGenie" in response.text
    assert "Ask an Academic Question" in response.text


def test_get_health():
    """Verify health endpoint returns status ok and service name."""
    response = client.get("/health")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data["status"] == "ok"
    assert data["service"] == "EduGenie"


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Input Validation Tests (No Gemini Quota Required)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
def test_qa_validation_error():
    """Empty or whitespace question should trigger 422 Unprocessable Entity."""
    response = client.post("/qa", json={"question": ""})
    assert response.status_code == 422


def test_explain_validation_error():
    """Empty or too short topic should trigger 422."""
    response = client.post("/explain", json={"topic": "a"})
    assert response.status_code == 422


def test_quiz_validation_error():
    """Text too short or invalid count should trigger 422."""
    response1 = client.post("/quiz", json={"text": "Short", "count": 3})
    assert response1.status_code == 422

    response2 = client.post(
        "/quiz",
        json={
            "text": "This is a sufficiently long educational passage for quiz validation testing.",
            "count": 0
        }
    )
    assert response2.status_code == 422


def test_summarize_validation_error():
    """Empty or short text should trigger 422."""
    response = client.post("/summarize", json={"text": "abc"})
    assert response.status_code == 422


def test_learning_path_validation_error():
    """Unsupported difficulty level or empty topic should trigger 422."""
    response1 = client.post(
        "/learn/recommendations",
        json={"topic": "Quantum Computing", "level": "super-expert"}
    )
    assert response1.status_code == 422

    response2 = client.post(
        "/learn/recommendations",
        json={"topic": "", "level": "beginner"}
    )

FILE: EduGenie/README.md

code Markdown
# EduGenie – Google Gemini Powered Learning Assistant

EduGenie is a full-stack, AI-powered learning and study assistant built with **FastAPI**, **Jinja2**, and the **Google GenAI Python SDK (`google-genai`)**. It is designed to empower students and educators with instant academic question answering, intuitive concept deconstruction, interactive multiple-choice quiz generation, high-yield summarization, and customized step-by-step learning roadmaps.

---

## 🌟 Key Features

1. **Academic Question Answering (`POST /qa`)**:
   - Concise, student-friendly, and accurate answers to homework and curriculum questions.
2. **Concept Simplification (`POST /explain`)**:
   - Structured multi-part breakdowns: Simple Definition, How It Works, Key Points to Remember, Real-World Example, and a Catchy Memory Trick/Mnemonic.
3. **Interactive Practice Quizzes (`POST /quiz`)**:
   - Generates 3, 5, or 10 multiple-choice questions from user text.
   - Enforces 4 distinct choices and 1 exact answer.
   - Immediate feedback in the web UI (Green for correct, Red with answer reveal for wrong, live score tracker).
4. **Smart Study Summarizer (`POST /summarize`)**:
   - Distills long texts into core takeaways, critical bullet points, and quick revision notes without hallucinations.
5. **Personalized Learning Roadmaps (`POST /learn/recommendations`)**:
   - Produces tailored milestones from Beginner to Advanced with estimated timelines, subtopics, resources, and retention strategies.

---

## 🏗️ Project Architecture & File Tree

```text
EduGenie/
│
├── main.py                     # FastAPI application, route declarations, template mounting
├── config.py                   # Pydantic Settings & environment variable loader
├── schemas.py                  # Pydantic request/response models with input validation
├── gemini_client.py            # Modern Google GenAI SDK client & error-resilient wrappers
├── qna.py                      # Academic Q&A engine
├── explanation_module.py       # Concept breakdown engine
├── quiz_module.py              # Structured multiple-choice quiz generator
├── summary_module.py           # Study notes and text summarizer
├── learning_path.py            # Personalized curriculum and roadmap generator
│
├── requirements.txt            # Python dependencies (FastAPI, google-genai, Pydantic, etc.)
├── .env.example                # Sample environment configuration
├── .gitignore                  # Git exclusion rules
├── README.md                   # Comprehensive documentation
├── pytest.ini                  # Pytest test discovery settings
│
├── templates/
│   └── index.html              # Responsive Jinja2 web dashboard
│
├── static/
│   ├── style.css               # Clean modern educational UI stylesheet
│   └── app.js                  # Vanilla JavaScript for interactive UI & API calls
│
└── tests/
    └── test_api.py             # Unit, validation, and mocked API tests

⚙️ Prerequisites

  • Python 3.10+

  • A Google Gemini API Key from Google AI Studio.

🚀 Quickstart Installation Guide

1. Clone or Copy the Repository

Navigate to the EduGenie directory:

code Bash
cd EduGenie

2. Create and Activate a Python Virtual Environment

On Linux / macOS:

code Bash
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate

On Windows:

code Cmd
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate

3. Install Dependencies

code Bash
pip install -r requirements.txt

4. Configure Environment Variables

Copy .env.example to .env:

code Bash
cp .env.example .env

Open .env in your text editor and add your API key:

code Env
GEMINI_API_KEY=AIzaSy...Your_Actual_API_Key_Here
GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-2.5-flash
APP_HOST=127.0.0.1
APP_PORT=8000
DEBUG=False

🏃 Running the Application

Launch the server using Uvicorn:

code Bash
uvicorn main:app --reload

Or execute directly with Python:

code Bash
python main.py

Access URLs:

  • Interactive Web App: http://127.0.0.1:8000

  • Interactive Swagger API Docs: http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs

  • Alternative ReDoc API Docs: http://127.0.0.1:8000/redoc

  • System Health Check: http://127.0.0.1:8000/health

🧪 Running the Test Suite

Execute automated unit and schema tests with pytest:

code Bash
pytest -v

All route validation tests execute without consuming Gemini API quota.

📡 API Endpoints Reference

MethodEndpointDescriptionSample Request Payload
GET/Web UI DashboardNone
GET/healthSystem Health CheckNone
POST/qaAnswer student question{"question": "Why is the sky blue?"}
POST/explainDeconstruct a concept{"topic": "Pythagoras theorem"}
POST/quizGenerate MCQs{"text": "Photosynthesis is...", "count": 3}
POST/summarizeSummarize long passage{"text": "The Industrial Revolution was..."}
POST/learn/recommendationsPersonalized curriculum{"topic": "SQL", "level": "beginner"}

🛠️ Troubleshooting

  1. GEMINI_API_KEY is missing or unconfigured:

    • Ensure you created a .env file containing GEMINI_API_KEY=your_key in the EduGenie/ root directory.

    • Alternatively, export it in your shell: export GEMINI_API_KEY="your_key".

  2. ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'google.genai':

    • Run pip install google-genai inside your activated .venv. Note: EduGenie uses the modern google-genai SDK, not the deprecated google-generativeai.

  3. Port already in use:

    • If port 8000 is occupied, run on another port:

      code Bash
      uvicorn main:app --port 8080 --reload

code Bash
uvicorn main:app --reload

5. Browser URL

6. Swagger URL

  • Swagger UI: http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs

  • ReDoc UI: http://127.0.0.1:8000/redoc

7. Test Command

code Bash
pytest -v

8. API Endpoint List

  • GET / — Responsive web dashboard with interactive tools

  • GET /health — Health check endpoint ({"status": "ok", "service": "EduGenie"})

  • GET /docs & GET /redoc — Auto-generated OpenAPI documentation

  • POST /qa — Academic Q&A tool

  • POST /explain — 5-point concept breakdown

  • POST /quiz — MCQ quiz generator with verified options and answers

  • POST /summarize — High-yield exam revision summarizer

  • POST /learn/recommendations — Step-by-step personalized curriculum generator

9. Troubleshooting

  • Missing API Key: If GEMINI_API_KEY is not provided, endpoints return HTTP 503 with an informative error rather than crashing the application.

  • Port Conflict: Specify --port 8080 if default port 8000 is occupied.

  • Modern SDK: Uses the official google-genai library and avoids deprecated imports.
